statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-89157: PCRE2 before 10.48, on platforms with a 32-bit size_t, can write out of bounds in pcre2_pattern_convert() when an attacker supplies a large pattern. Upstream fixed it in PCRE2 10.48 (item 26 of the 10.48 ChangeLog, pull request https://github.com/PCRE2Project/pcre2/pull/909; https://github.com/PCRE2Project/pcre2/security/advisories/GHSA-q8g2-wprr-34m9, https://github.com/PCRE2Project/pcre2/releases/tag/pcre2-10.48). The DHI Alpine 3.23 pcre2 packages are built from Alpine's aports APKBUILD for the same version, which applies no patches to the upstream PCRE2 release tarball. The published builds of the pcre2 source in the DHI Alpine 3.23 repository are 10.47-r0, 10.48-r0 and 10.49-r0. The version string compiled into libpcre2-8, libpcre2-16 and libpcre2-32 (the pcre2, libpcre2-16 and libpcre2-32 packages) was read from every one of these builds on x86_64 and aarch64 and matches the package version: 10.47-r0 reports PCRE2 10.47, which lacks the fix, and 10.48-r0 and 10.49-r0 report 10.48 and 10.49, which include it. The advisory limits it to 32-bit platforms and every DHI pcre2 build is 64-bit (x86_64 and aarch64); the range still records the first build that carries the fix.
